summary: REVIEW FAILED. Task T7 adds the pr-reviewer agent (model claude-opus-5-5 pinned, no Agent tool, review-pr preloaded, reply file pr-reviewer-pr<number>-r<round>.json that agrees with name.rs and the schema), moves the profile's output, merged-PR and recording rules into review-pr, and records 21 inventory rows; linter all and the validators pass. One rule fails AC6 and P2 as T7 applies them: 'review against the actual diff and the CI context, not local intent' is workflow text that lives only in the agent file, so a session that runs review-pr without the agent loses it. Three minor and two nit findings concern the verdict mapping, the severity list of the Output and small duplication. AC1, AC5 to AC10 and the issue-level checkboxes wait on later tasks.

findings.location: .claude/agents/pr-reviewer.md, section Workflow; removed-profile-rules.md, row 'Review against the actual diff and the CI context, not local intent'
findings.description: Workflow text in the agent file (P2, AC6, policy 7 of AGENTS.md; the same kind of finding that failed T6 round 1). The sentence 'Review the real diff and the checks of the pull request, not the intent of the caller' is a review rule, not identity, tools, inputs or report format, and review-pr does not hold it (its Quick Overview only says 'Check the diff for scope of change'). Remediation: move the rule into review-pr (for example the Quick Overview or the Output paragraph that gathers the checks), keep the agent file pointing to the skill, and change the inventory row's destination to the skill section.

findings.location: .claude/skills/review-pr/SKILL.md, A Reply File, the verdict bullet
findings.description: The mapping to the closed verdict list is incomplete: it maps COMMENT only 'when no blocker remains', so a COMMENT with an unresolved blocker has no verdict, and the orchestrator reads only that field. Remediation: map every Output verdict, for example 'COMMENT with an unresolved blocker gives REVIEW_FAILED', or state that a review with an unresolved blocker is always REQUEST_CHANGES (which the Output's 'Do not approve while a blocker is unresolved' does not say for COMMENT).

Output lists three severities (Blocker, Suggestion, Nit) while Providing Feedback and the reply file's findings use five (Blocker, Major, Minor, Nit, Suggestion); the inventory notes the difference but leaves the skill inconsistent with itself. Remediation: make item 2 'Findings by severity (the five severities of Providing Feedback)' or list all five.

findings.location: .claude/skills/review-pr/SKILL.md, Quick Overview Approach and the procedural paragraph under Output
findings.description: Two procedures in one skill: the Quick Overview steps (read title and description, check the diff, apply the checklist) and the new paragraph under the Output heading (confirm the PR exists, gather the metadata and checks, review and classify) describe the same sequence, and the second sits under a heading about what to return. Remediation: merge the steps into one ordered list (the Quick Overview, renamed if needed) and keep Output for what is returned.

findings.location: .claude/skills/review-pr/SKILL.md, A Branch Without The pr-reviewer Agent
findings.description: The section says 'as the same section of review-task describes' and then restates part of that procedure (create from the template, read whole, append one entry). Remediation: keep only the link plus the PR-specific fields to record, so the append-only procedure has one source.

findings.location: removed-profile-rules.md, row 'Do not run the pre-pull-request task acceptance review'
findings.description: The note says review-pr 'already held it', but before T7 the skill only redirected a branch without a PR to review-task; the sentence 'do not run the acceptance review of a task' was added by T7. Remediation: say 'Moved by task T7; the redirect at the top of the skill already existed'.
